name: Escape Green
notes: Escape Green 0.1.0-r3. Chunky 32 px HUD hearts with a dark outline and a clear empty state. Minecraft-style first-person sword (silver blade, gold crossguard, wrapped grip) with I/B docked at the right of the hotbar. Translucent jelly slimes. Denser dusk jungle with tall trunks, layered canopy overhead, hanging vines, and near-camera ferns and big leaves. Keep-playing overlay still clears held movement. Right-click with a block selected places that block. Touch controls fill the viewport at tablet and phone sizes (joystick, jump, attack, build). HUD SVG icons are original to this project. Save schema: engine v5 plus Escape Green schema v1. IDB name and Workbox cacheId prefix stay escape-green. SW denylist unchanged. Debug stays inert without ?debug. PROXY draw-call caps: High <=150, Low <=70 (Low target <=62). Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
